description: What do omitted, null, [] and "" mean in this PATCH body under merge-patch, JSON Patch or a declared dialect? — For an agent about to send a PATCH or update body: states, per field, what omitted / null / [] / "" mean under the declared dialect (RFC 7396 merge patch, RFC 6902 JSON Patch, or caller-declared semantics) and checks the body against stated intents such as 'clear this field', 'leave this alone' or 'set to empty array'. callerSemantics.description: Required when dialect is 'caller': what each payload form means in that API.

dialect.description: merge-patch = RFC 7396, json-patch = RFC 6902 (payload is an array of operations), caller = semantics in callerSemantics.

target.description: Current document, if available. Enables applying the patch and exact checks.
